name: key
meaning: study key: first author and year

name: species
meaning: species as the source names it

name: ncbitaxon
meaning: NCBITaxon identifier of the species

name: taxon_match
meaning: how the species matched NCBITaxon: its label, or a synonym of the label given

name: year
meaning: publication year

name: country
meaning: country where the study was done

name: subject
meaning: irradiated propagule: seed, bulb, tuber, callus, protocorm, shoot culture or cutting

name: te
meaning: study type (TE axis); kept for audit, as the review retired the axis as recoverable from EP

name: ff
meaning: phenological phase of the propagule primarily irradiated (FF axis)

name: dr
meaning: shape of the reported dose-response curve (DR axis); empty when not resolvable

name: mm
meaning: statistical model used for the dose-response (MM axis)

name: ep
meaning: endpoint category (EP axis)

name: source
meaning: radiation source: Co-60 or Cs-137; empty when the study does not state it

name: highest_dose_reported
meaning: highest dose irradiated, as reported

name: highest_dose_gy
meaning: highest dose in Gy; roentgens converted at 8.77 mGy per roentgen (air kerma), a lower estimate of the dose to water

name: dose_rate_reported
meaning: dose rate as reported; empty when not reported

name: dose_rate_gy_per_h
meaning: dose rate in Gy per hour

name: n_treatments
meaning: number of dose treatments, control included where the source counts it; empty when not reported

name: ci_reported
meaning: yes when the study publishes a confidence interval or fiducial limits for its threshold dose

name: first_author
meaning: family name of the first author as printed

name: doi
meaning: DOI of the source

name: citation
meaning: bibliographic citation, for sources without a DOI

name: source_note
meaning: where the Crossref record of the DOI differs from the printed byline, year or status

name: recode_note
meaning: the code changed from the review, and the sentence of the source that decides it

name: TE1
meaning: physiological study

name: TE2
meaning: genetic study

name: TE3
meaning: biochemical study

name: FF1
meaning: dry seed

name: FF2
meaning: hydrated seed

name: FF3
meaning: seedling

name: FF4
meaning: vegetative tissue or in vitro culture (bulb, tuber, cutting, shoot culture, callus, protocorm)

name: DR1
meaning: biphasic (hormetic) dose-response

name: DR2
meaning: monotonic decreasing

name: DR3
meaning: monotonic increasing

name: DR4
meaning: complex non-monotonic

name: (empty)
meaning: shape not resolvable from the report

name: MM1
meaning: analysis of variance with mean-comparison tests, no fitted curve

name: MM2
meaning: Brain-Cousens or log-logistic model with a stimulation term (no study in the corpus)

name: MM3
meaning: other: non-parametric tests, genetic parameters, sequencing

name: MM4
meaning: quantal model: probit or logit on the proportion surviving

name: MM5
meaning: curve fitted directly to percentages (straight line, polynomial or a curve-fitting program)

name: EP1
meaning: emergence and early vigour

name: EP2
meaning: biochemistry

name: EP3
meaning: genetics

name: EP4
meaning: morphology and anatomy

name: EP5
meaning: plant health

name: EP6
meaning: other physiological
